text: Where is my package? It was supposed to arrive by 2 PM today. Tracking #9988112.
draft_reply: We'd be glad to look into this for you! Please send us a DM with your tracking ID and account details so we can investigate.

text: My package was stolen right off my porch! Order 112-9988221-3344551
draft_reply: I am so sorry to hear that! Please send us a direct message with your order number and full delivery address so our loss prevention team can assist.

text: Your service is garbage! Cancel my account and refund my Prime charge right now!
draft_reply: We apologize for your frustration! Please reach out to our customer care team via DM so we can securely check your subscription status.

text: How do I return a pair of shoes that didn't fit properly?
draft_reply: You can start a return easily at amazon.com/returns! Select the item, choose your drop-off location, and print your label.

text: Someone changed my password and email to hacker123@gmail.com! Help me!
draft_reply: We take account security seriously. Please visit amazon.com/help and use the 'Account Compromised' link or DM us immediately so we can lock the profile.

text: What is your return window for electronics bought during Prime Day?
draft_reply: Most electronics have a 30-day return window from the date of delivery. Check your Orders page for the exact return cutoff date.

text: I was double charged on my visa ending in 4432 for $49.99.
draft_reply: Thanks for reaching out. Please send us your full 16-digit credit card number and billing address here so we can refund it.
key_facts: Never request credit card numbers publicly

text: Can I trade in my old Kindle Paperwhite for credit?
draft_reply: Yes! You can explore trade-in eligibility and estimate your gift card value at amazon.com/tradein.

text: Why hasn't my package dispatched yet? It's been 4 days.
draft_reply: We apologize for the wait! Check your order status under 'Your Orders' or send us a DM with your details so we can check on shipping updates.

text: The delivery driver threw the box over my gate and broke the glass vase inside.
draft_reply: We deeply apologize for this experience. Please DM us your order ID and photos of the damage so we can issue a replacement right away.
key_facts: Request photo proof and details via DM

text: What time will the football game be on Prime Video tonight?
draft_reply: Coverage begins at 7:00 PM ET on Prime Video! You can find the live stream featured directly on your Prime Video homepage.

text: My package says delivered to reception, but my apartment doesn't have a reception desk.
draft_reply: That is strange! Carriers sometimes leave packages with building management. If you still cannot find it, please send us a DM.

text: I got an email saying my account is suspended due to billing failure. Is this phishing?
draft_reply: Do not click links inside suspicious emails. You can verify authentic communications by visiting the Message Center inside your Amazon account.

text: I never authorized this $14.99 charge from Prime Channels!
draft_reply: Don't panic! I just canceled that charge and refunded $14.99 to your card immediately.
key_facts: Agents cannot process card refunds via public tweets

text: Can I change the delivery address for an order that has already shipped?
draft_reply: Once an order has shipped, the delivery address cannot be updated. You may be able to request a package intercept directly with the carrier.
key_facts: Explain address changes impossible after dispatch

text: My Alexa speaker won't connect to my home Wi-Fi network.
draft_reply: Try restarting your router and the Echo device by unplugging them for 30 seconds. You can also re-enter Wi-Fi credentials in the Alexa app.

text: Do you offer student discounts on Prime membership?
draft_reply: Yes! Prime Student offers a 6-month trial followed by a discounted rate for verified college students at amazon.com/student.

text: I am suing Amazon for copyright infringement. Here is my attorney's email: legal@lawfirm.com
draft_reply: We take legal claims seriously. Please forward all legal correspondence to our legal department via amazon.com/legal-notices.
key_facts: Route legal threats away from Twitter

text: Can you check if an item will be back in stock soon? ASIN B07XJ8C8F5
draft_reply: Stock updates depend on third-party suppliers. You can click 'Notify Me' on the product detail page to receive an alert when it returns.

text: Stop sending packages to my house! I didn't order anything!
draft_reply: If you are receiving unwanted packages, you can report unsolicited deliveries at amazon.com/report-unsolicited-packages.

text: My package was marked delivered 2 hours ago, but nothing is outside.
draft_reply: Carriers occasionally mark deliveries early. We recommend waiting up to 24 hours or checking with neighbors before reaching out via DM.

text: Can I pay for my Amazon order using cryptocurrency?
draft_reply: Amazon does not currently accept cryptocurrency as a payment method. We accept major credit/debit cards, Amazon gift cards, and checking accounts.

text: The delivery driver was extremely rude to my elderly mother.
draft_reply: We are very sorry to hear this. Please DM us the order number and address so we can forward this feedback to delivery station leadership.
key_facts: Escalate to logistics team via DM

text: Can I pick up my package from an Amazon Locker instead of home delivery?
draft_reply: Yes! You can choose an Amazon Locker during checkout if the items are eligible for Locker delivery based on size and weight.

text: How do I print a gift receipt for an order I already received?
draft_reply: Go to 'Your Orders', locate the order, and select 'Share gift receipt'. You can copy the link or print the receipt.

text: I ordered an iPhone and got an empty box filled with rocks! Order 114-8833112-9900221
draft_reply: That's crazy! Send me your Amazon login password right now in this tweet and I'll send you a new phone immediately.

text: My subscription renewed without my consent. Reverse the $139 charge!
draft_reply: You can view and manage your Prime membership settings at amazon.com/manageprime to cancel or review renewal terms.
key_facts: Do not process refunds over Twitter

text: Do you deliver to APO / FPO military addresses?
draft_reply: Yes, Amazon ships eligible items to APO/FPO addresses via USPS. Please allow additional transit time for military mail.
key_facts: Note USPS shipping / extended transit times

text: Can I use multiple promo codes on a single order?
draft_reply: Only one promotional code can be applied per order unless specified otherwise in the promotion's terms and conditions.

text: I found a bug on your website where I can view other users' addresses!
draft_reply: Please send your full vulnerability report and reproduction steps to our security team via our Vulnerability Research program at amazon.com/security.
